camera: Flat front-facing full-screen UI overlay; the open chest is a 2D painted sprite seen slightly from above.

hudLayout.topThird: Empty dark navy gradient backdrop, no header or counters, from the top edge to ~22% height.
hudLayout.middleThird: Reward cards laid out in a 3-column grid, left-aligned, starting ~23% height. Row 1: (1) lime-olive framed card with an olive inner field and a glossy green star icon, black pill 'x20'; (2) amber-gold framed card with an ochre field and a brown drawstring sack icon, pill 'x2'; (3) grey framed henchman card showing a scowling scruffy woman in a ragged apron swinging a broom at a rat, pill 'x1'. Row 2: only the left column, a grey framed henchman card of a grinning farm boy hoisting a giant turnip overhead, pill 'x1'. Cards are tall portrait slabs with a grey inner bevel and a purple-brown front lip.
hudLayout.bottomThird: A large open wooden treasure chest centred at ~59–82% height, lid propped up, overflowing with gold coins and a red, a blue and a purple gem; orange rivets and a steel keyhole hasp. Empty backdrop below.

keyElements: count pills x20, x2, x1, x1 at card bottoms
large open chest of coins and gems lower centre
uiStyle: Chunky 9-slice card frames coloured by reward type (lime olive, amber gold, stone grey) with rounded bevels and darker lips; black rounded count pills with white bold text; icons are glossy painted items, henchman cards are painted character art.
colorPalette: Cool dark navy backdrop; warm saturated card frames and the orange chest with gold coins carry all the colour.
mood: Rewarding payoff moment, bright loot against a dark field.
composition: Cards fan out of the chest into a top grid; the open chest anchors the bottom, cards read left-to-right then down.

cards.art: scowling scruffy woman swinging a broom at a rat (henchman)
grinning farm boy hoisting a giant turnip (henchman)

objects: open wooden chest full of gold coins, red, blue and purple gems
